PRIVACY AND ENQUIRIES

A small first conversation.

QuietBatch is operated by Theunis Christian Botha, a sole proprietor in South Africa. Contact quietbatchreports@gmail.com about an enquiry or a privacy request.

When you browse

This page has no analytics script, advertising tracker, sign-in, upload form or payment collection. The reporting example runs with fictional data in your browser. The hosting provider may process technical connection information, such as an IP address, for delivery and security.

When you email

Email links open a draft in your own email app. Sending is your choice. Your name, email address and the details you choose to share are used to respond, assess whether the pilot fits and prepare a requested quote. An enquiry is not consent to a marketing mailing list.

Please send only a short description initially. Do not send passwords, bank details, tax identifiers, medical or payroll records, or production customer exports.

Service providers and storage

The business mailbox uses Gmail. Its provider may process information outside South Africa under its own service terms. Necessary local business records are kept separately; the mailbox is not the sole tax-record archive. Production-data access, storage, retention and deletion are agreed before files are transferred for a pilot.

Retention and your choices

Unsuccessful enquiries are planned for deletion within 90 days of the last exchange, unless you ask us to keep the conversation open or retention is required for a lawful purpose. Necessary contract, invoice, tax and dispute records are retained for the period applicable to those records. The enquiry review is manual.

You may request access, correction or deletion, or ask us to stop optional contact. Legal record-keeping duties may limit deletion. You may complain to South Africa's Information Regulator. No claim of registration or certification is made by this notice.

Enquiries and orders

The website invites enquiries. It does not accept orders or take payment. Read the seller details and pilot terms, including business contact and legal-service address. The written quote confirms the agreed scope, delivery slot, data arrangements and EFT payment instructions before an order is accepted. Applicable statutory rights remain available.

Prepared 29 September 2026. This notice describes the first enquiry process; material changes to that process require a notice update.
